description: Festival speech synthesizer for NVDA with English and Czech voices (kal, ked, czech_ph, czech_dita, czech_krb, czech_machac). Festival runs in a 64-bit helper process (festhost64.exe), so a crash in Festival cannot close NVDA; speech is played by NVDA with pitch, audio ducking and exact index reporting. More voices can be downloaded from festvox.org (NVDA menu, Tools, Festival voices). NVDA 2026.1 and later.
